market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver currently trades near $32/oz; reaching $120 by end of June 2026 would require a >300% gain in ~15 months, far exceeding any historical rally including the 2011 peak. The all-time high is ~$50, so $120 represents an unprecedented move. Even in extreme inflation or supply-crunch scenarios, such a rise is a tail risk, likely below 1% probability. The market's 6.8% implied odds overprice this outcome.
evidence_points: Silver spot price ~$32 as of April 2025
Requires >300% rise in ~15 months, unprecedented in modern silver history
sources_consulted: Historical silver price data (e.g., Kitco, Macrotrends)
